LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingEnabled: Doctors give pain relief on their own
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingEnabledDesc: A patient who is down or in bed and in severe pain gets the best painkiller within reach; in extreme pain, a sedative when no medical painkiller can be given. Off, nothing is given without your order.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingMinimumCare: Dose patients whose medical care is at least
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingMinimumCareDesc: Only patients whose medical care setting is this level or better are dosed. "No medicine" and "no medical care" are never dosed.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingRecreationalDesc: Off by default: only medical drugs are given. On, social and hard drugs that relieve pain may be given as a last resort, when no medical painkiller or sedative can be.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingIgnoreAversion: Give medical drugs to patients who refuse drugs
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingIgnoreAversionDesc: Off by default: a patient who would not take drugs (a teetotaler, or by belief) is not dosed. On, medical drugs are given anyway; recreational ones never.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingRemovalNote: Nothing is saved: the mod can be added or removed at any time. A drug already given keeps working as its own mod says.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalSedativeNotWanted: only a sedative ({DRUG}) is in reach, and the pain is not that bad
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalRecreationalOff: only a recreational drug ({DRUG}) is in reach, and doctors here will not give it for pain
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalCare: the patient's medical care level does not allow it
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalMentalState: the patient is in an aggressive mental state
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalStillActive: an earlier dose is still working
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalDangerousDose: another dose of {DRUG} would be dangerous
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalConsciousness: {DRUG} would leave the patient too close to unconsciousness
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalBreathing: {DRUG} would leave the patient unable to breathe
